questions.subject: AI Agents
questions.question: Explain the difference between agent architecture and planning in AI Agents.
questions.ideal_answer: agent architecture and planning differ in several ways: agent architecture is autonomous AI system (works by perception, reasoning, action loop) whereas planning is multi-step goal decomposition (works by breaking complex goals into actions). agent architecture is typically used for ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, AutoGPT, while planning is used for Hierarchical Task Networks, tree search. Example demonstrating agent architecture: observation -> thought -> action -> observation. Example demonstrating planning: plan -> execute -> observe -> replan.
